widgets_values:
Officially, both samplers, res_2s is recommended, but it takes twice as long! (https://github.com/ClownsharkBatwing/RES4LYF)
euler is ok. maybe not. 

The linear_quadratic is almost identical to the official input values. 
steps=8 denoise=1, steps=3 denoise=0.37 is default.
But it might be a value for the res2s sampler.

nodes.title: Release workflow
widgets_values:
Uses the released hybrid transformer and W4A8 Gemma text encoder.
Place example.png and example.mp3 in ComfyUI/input, or select your own files.
Both LoRA and QwenTTS experiment branches were removed from this public workflow.
Portable version: standard UNET, CLIP, VAE and tiled-decode nodes; no MultiGPU or memory helper nodes.
Hardware requirements and speed depend on ComfyUI offloading and available VRAM/RAM.

widgets_values_named.text:
lora: canny, depth, pose
https://huggingface.co/collections/Lightricks/ltx-2

You can use Canny, depth, and pose as inputs along with LoRA.

Input control data into both samplers will improve quality, but it will consume a lot of resources. 
For control data, it is recommended to disconnect the node connection and turn off the insert to Sampler2.

Also, it should be used a loader other than the first one, and the strength value should be set to 1.

(If you input to both samplers, both samplers must use the LoRA)

nodes.title: 2x frame
widgets_values:
When using temporal-upscaler(VFI),
Don't forget to set the final FPS to twice that of sampler1.
Simply disconnect link the FPS and enter the value.

(Once the calculation function is updated in ComfyUI, it will be possible to automate it.)

nodes.title: Image
widgets_values:
If you turn off all image, it's T2V.

frame_idx is the position where the image will be inserted.
higher image_compression values result in more motion.
strength=1: The image will be applied as is.
strength=0: The image will be ignored.

Except for the first image, the image aspect ratio is not maintained.
If the image uses a different aspect ratio than the video, do not bypass this upscale.

For video extension, inputting the images into the first loader can save resources.

nodes.title: Audio
widgets_values:
All audio settings are configured in seconds.

The loaded audio is trimmed from start_index to a length of duration, and then inserted at insert_idx.

placing an empty exemple.mp3 file in the ComfyUI\input folder will prevent errors.
